messages:
Emily P (Partnerships): Heads-up — co-hosted booth at CloudCon next week. Need a short failover plan if the live HW demo flakes and a swag pickup point for partners. Thoughts?
Raj S (Events): +1. Can we keep the demo to a 5-min happy-path and a 2-min fallback clip? less risky.
Marco G (Eng): Agreed. I'll make a prerecorded 2-min clip of the demo workload and a tiny script to reroute traffic to the hosted API.
Janine (Sales): Who's the partner speaker slot? we should confirm one slide highlighting marketplace listing.
Lorna (Logistics): Swag pickup — partner courier arrives Thu 6pm. Customs hold could happen. I'll add a fallback pickup at the venue storage desk.
Tom O (Ops): For live HW failover, propose this quick plan:
```
1) If device unreachable, switch to prerecorded video on loop.
2) Route attendees to demo laptop hooked to hosted API (low-cost fallback).
3) Use signage: "Live demo paused — see short walkthrough".
```
Marco G (Eng): I'll implement a small health-check monitor on the demo machine that flips an env var. Command is just: `curl -sS http://localhost:8000/health || ./switch_to_clip.sh`
Emily P (Partnerships): Raj — can you own speaker confirmation? ask partner to send final slide deck by Tue EOD.
Raj S (Events): Yep, pinged @partner-sre and @partner-ops. Also asked for a 1-paragraph blurb for the emcee.
Janine (Sales): I'll add marketplace CTA to slide 4 and send a short blurb for the partner.
Lorna (Logistics): Map for swag: partner-branded shirts (S/M/L), stickers, and 50 USBs. Where do we store overflow?
Tom O (Ops): Venue has a secure locker. I'll reserve locker #3 and add access code to the runbook.
Marco G (Eng): Small note: the demo needs USB passthrough for local model weights. If customs holds USBs, demo should still work w/ hosted fallback.
Emily P (Partnerships): Good call. Add a visible QR at the booth to the prerecorded clip + sign-up form.
Raj S (Events): Run-of-show draft: 10:00 - speaker intro, 10:05 - live demo (5m), 10:10 - Q&A / redirect to partner table. I'll drop it in the event doc.
Janine (Sales): Can we also have a live capture of leads? simple Google Form link works.
Lorna (Logistics): Partner courier ETA updated: Thu 17:40. If customs delay >30m, we go to fallback.
EventBot: Reminder — submit final AV deck to AV team by Tue 12:00 to avoid last-minute encoding issues.
Emily P (Partnerships): Checklist before show: 1) Partner slide deck received, 2) prerecorded clip uploaded to booth laptop + cloud, 3) health-check script on demo machine, 4) locker reserved + access code, 5) QR + lead capture form live, 6) partner swag manifest confirmed. Mark when done.
Marco G (Eng): I'll push the health-check to the demo repo and add docs. PR link: https://git.internal/demo-fallback (will update after PR).
Raj S (Events): I'll confirm speaker travel window and mic check time. Suggest we do a 10-min mic check 30m before session.
Janine (Sales): Noted. I'll bring extra sign-up tablets in case QR scan spikes.
Lorna (Logistics): Will coordinate courier to drop 1 box at main desk and the rest to locker.
Emily P (Partnerships): Perfect — last ask: partner contact for on-site escalation? add name + mobile.
Raj S (Events): Partner contact: Sofia M - +1-415-555-0147. Mentioned she'll be onsite from 9:30.
Emily P (Partnerships): Great. I'll update the shared runbook and close this thread. Thanks team :thumbsup:
